> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The round-1 coverage gap is closed. The added end-to-end masking scenarios independently drive a token-shaped, multiline, over-limit arbitrary exception through each of the four widened production handlers (stale-PR detection, issue status repair, stale-PR hand-off, and age un-park), and compare each emitted ALERT against a fixed literal independent of the masking regex, length bound, and injected message construction. A call-site regression to `str(exc)` at any one handler therefore fails its own row while the shared helper remains unchanged. The broader boundary handlers remain loud, preserve per-object continuation, and retain phase-level systemic-failure precedence and lease release. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue remains in the diff.
